name: Sunshine Coast Airport

runway.v: One runway, 13/31, 2,800 m × 45 m (RWY 13 TORA 2,625 m; RWY 31 LDA 2,450 m). RWY 18/36 decommissioned.
runway.quote: 2800 x 45; RWY 13 LDA / ASDA / TORA 2625M; RWY 31 LDA 2450M

curfew.v: Aircraft above 5,700 kg need prior approval from the airport operator to operate between 23:00 and 05:30 local (13:00–19:30 UTC).
curfew.quote: ACFT ABV 5,700KG RQ prior approval of AD OPR to OPR BTN HR of 2300 and 0530 Local.

ppr.v: All non-RPT GA light jets and turbine aircraft need prior approval from the airport operator, 48 hours notice (security requirement).
ppr.quote: Due to security requirements, all GA light jet and turbine ACFT which are not RPT, must obtain prior approval FM AD OPR ... To obtain such approval 48HR notice is required

hours.v: Tower 21:00–09:40 UTC daily (07:00–19:40 local); outside these hours the airspace is Class G. Rescue and firefighting daily 19:45–10:55 UTC except Monday (19:45–13:20 UTC).

fuel.v: Jet A-1 by Viva Energy 19:00–10:00 UTC daily (05:00–20:00 local), 30 minutes prior notice; Avgas 24 hours by card bowser.
fuel.quote: DLY 1900-1000 UTC ... JET A1 30 MIN PN

handling.v: FBOs listed: MachJet (H24), Swissport, Flight Options (H24). The airport operator does not provide marshalling.
handling.quote: AD OPR does not provide marshalling services.

noise.v: Noise abatement procedures apply (see AIP DAP).
noise.quote: Noise Abatement Procedures (NAP) apply. Refer AIP DAP.
